column1: # Root retention manifest (ROADMAP R-0562; P6, P8, P14, P21). One row per asset group.
# disposition: retained = stays live at the root (outside legacy/, survives its deletion);
#   migrate = moves to legacy/ and returns as slices need it, deleted only by its own criterion;
#   archived = moves to legacy/ and stays readable, never run, never deleted automatically;
#   retire = the old pipeline (compiler, build files, its gates and tooling), deleted with legacy/ at LD (R-0590).
# PATHS: a space-separated list. Assets are named by their path before the move; after it, a path
# legacy/P is the same asset as P (scripts/land/retention.py strips the prefix). A retained row also
# names the new root's path of the file (docs/project/AGENTS.md is AGENTS.md at the root). A new root
# file and its legacy/ namesake (lakefile.toml, legacy/lakefile.toml) share a row; the row describes
# the legacy/ copy, and the root file is the new root's own (scripts/checks/root_inventory.txt).
# PRECEDENCE: a path is governed by the row naming its longest listed prefix, so a specific row
# (docs/spec/decisions.md) governs inside a broad one (docs). No path may be listed twice.
# check_retention_manifest.sh checks that every tracked file has exactly one governing row.
# STATUS: open | resolved, and it is about the legacy/ copy only. A row is resolved when its
# deletion criterion for the legacy/ copy holds, recorded by the change that resolves it. Deleting a
# path under legacy/ needs EVERY row covering the path (its own and each ancestor's) resolved
# (scripts/checks/legacy_frozen.sh after the move). legacy/ is deleted only at LD (R-0590), way later (the phase is not yet chosen),

# when no row is open, a final ideas sweep has dispositioned every idea and the owner approves (P6, revised 2026-11-06). This manifest never authorizes deleting a live root file: a retained row's criterion
# reads "root: <when the root file goes, normally never>; legacy/ copy: <when its frozen duplicate
# may go>", and resolving it releases only the legacy/ copy.
# FIRST DRAFT, 2026-11-04, from the tree at b78fff1a5; the owner approves it with the move (R-0558).
